caption:
RM 1,240 in your bank. only RM 18 a day is actually yours 🌿

you open the bank app and it says RM1,240. feels fine. then the 1st comes and rent takes 650. PTPTN takes 200. pay-later instalment 3 of 6 is 120, and the phone bill is 48 on the 8th.

that leaves 222, and payday is 12 days away. so the real number was about RM18 a day the whole time. the bank app just never says that part.

that's why we built I-Rimba. it skips the wall of transactions and shows 1 number: what's safe to spend today, with every bill due before payday already set aside. log spending the way you'd text a friend, "spent 12 on lunch with TNG", and it sorts it for you. bills get a countdown so none of them sneak up.

it's built for ringgit and Malaysian e-wallets, and there's a demo you can open right now at irimba.harnova.my.

share this with the friend who checks their balance and panics 👇
